title: ICMR Standard Treatment Workflow: Hypertension in Adults
notes: Read local lines 90-94: adherence, lifestyle, BP monitoring and annual renal/metabolic surveillance. Used only non-prescribing content. Synthetic benchmark draft pending independent clinical review.

title: ICMR Standard Treatment Workflow: Diabetes Mellitus Type 2
notes: Read lines 1786-1851, especially ASSESS, INVESTIGATION, MONITORING and REFERRALS. Used for established diabetes monitoring, foot/eye surveillance and lifestyle, not prescribing or diagnosis.

title: ICMR Standard Treatment Workflow: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
notes: Read lines 5287-5380, especially TREATMENT non-drug advice and symptom-change assessment. Does not support autonomous exacerbation classification or medication changes.

title: ICMR Standard Treatment Workflow: Chronic Kidney Disease
notes: Read lines 1702-1765: evaluation, renal/electrolyte results and medication exposure. Historical local workflow; use only evaluation concepts, with current NICE guidance for monitoring. No prescribing recommendations imported.

title: NICE NG136: Hypertension in adults, recommendations
notes: Verified through primary-site search excerpts: 1.4.15-1.4.18 BP monitoring, standing BP for postural symptoms/age 80+, and discordant readings. Used for CHR-002 and CHR-003.

title: NICE NG28: Blood glucose management
notes: Verified primary-site text for 1.5.1 and 1.5.5: HbA1c monitoring and individual targets. February 2026 update. Used for monitoring, not drug selection.

title: NICE NG245: Asthma diagnosis, monitoring and chronic management
notes: Primary search text verified sections 1.4, 1.5, 1.6.1/1.6.7 and 1.14-1.16: occupational symptoms, control, technique, adherence, personalised action plans and follow-up. Direct open returned 403; verified search extracts are the access basis. No prescribing criteria included.

title: NICE NG203: Chronic kidney disease assessment and management
notes: Primary search text verified monitoring section 1.3, dietary advice 1.4.7-1.4.9 and albuminuria/referral text 1.6.7. Direct open returned 403. Used for monitoring and review, not medication selection.

title: ATS: Pulmonary Rehabilitation for Adults with Chronic Respiratory Disease
notes: Primary ATS search text verified recommendations for stable COPD, after hospitalisation for exacerbation, and choice of centre-based or telerehabilitation. DOI direct open failed; publisher/ATS indexed text verified.

title: NHS: Living with COPD
notes: Opened page: regular review, weight loss/dietitian, vaccination and exposure advice. Use clinician review of vaccine status, not a new vaccine order or schedule.

title: NHS: Sprains and strains
notes: Opened page, reviewed 23 April 2024. Early protection/cold therapy, movement as pain permits, delayed recovery/physiotherapy and reassessment warnings. Cases already clinician-established; does not authorize new diagnosis or analgesic prescribing.

title: Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust: Bruise advice
notes: Opened page, reviewed 28 August 2025: elevation and cold compress with skin barrier. Used for uncomplicated contusion comfort measures.

title: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia: Bruise
notes: Opened page, reviewed 1 April 2025: anticoagulant-associated bruising, protective first aid and seeking care for concerning pain/pressure or infection. Public national-library-hosted clinical reference; supplementary to primary NHS advice.

title: NHS: Cuts and grazes
notes: Opened page, reviewed 2 April 2026: wound cleaning, clean/dry dressing, tetanus protection assessment and infection/bleeding warning signs. No antibiotic or vaccine prescribing criteria.

title: NHS: Burns and scalds
notes: Opened page, reviewed 31 March 2026: twenty-minute cooling within three hours, non-sticky protection, no ice/oils or blister bursting, healing follow-up. Only clinician-established small non-critical-site burns used; case-specific dressing/nurse details remain case facts.
